user.description: Home Assistant can see these Huion notebooks. Pick one, or enter a Bluetooth address.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Handwritten pages will be pulled automatically whenever Home Assistant sees the notebook.

pick_device.description: Pick the notebook. It must be awake and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

manual.description: Enter the notebook's Bluetooth address (e.g. `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`), or pick it from the nearby devices listed (strongest signal first; wake the notebook and it should be near the top). The notebook doesn't have to be in range now — pages sync the next time Home Assistant sees it.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

data.delete_after_sync: Delete pages from the notebook after they are saved
data.pin: Device PIN (6 digits, only if set on the notebook)

data_description.delete_after_sync: Only complete pages with strokes whose SVG, JSON and PNG are safely on disk are deleted. The current (last) page is always kept.
data_description.output_dir: Defaults to huion_notes in your media folder, so pages show up in the Media browser.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.

auth_failed.title: {name} needs its PIN
auth_failed.description: Home Assistant couldn't sign in to {name}: {reason}. Automatic syncs are paused. Open *Settings → Devices & services → Huion Note X10 → Configure*, enter the notebook's 6-digit PIN (or correct it) and save; syncing resumes the next time the notebook is seen.
